newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska farmers make excellent seeding progress.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska farmers make excellent seeding progress.

text.p: A week of good weather allowed Nebraska farmers to make excellent planting progress in the week ended Sunday, according to the State Agricultural Statistics Service.
Corn plantings were 70 percent complete. That figure compared with last week's pace of 30 percent, a year-ago pace of 74 percent and the five-year average of 55 percent.
Oats were 98 percent planted, up from 87 percent last week and up from the five-year average of 96 percent.
Winter wheat conditions declined from the previous week with one percent rated very poor, seven percent poor, 38 percent fair, 47 percent good and seven percent excellent.

Pasture and range conditions also dropped slightly from the previous week with two percent rated very poor, five percent poor, 31 percent fair, 36 percent good and six percent excellent, the report said.
"Pasture growth continued slow but improved where moisture was received and temperatures were warmer," the report said.
Topsoil moisture was rated one very short, 16 percent short, 79 percent adequate and four percent surplus.
